tasks.description: Implement the catalogue-defined typed report-query boundary, `SignalReportSourcePort` contract, and interactor behavior in `libs/usecase/src/signal_report/`, with independently verifiable mock-based port and interactor tests. GO-01, IN-01–IN-04, CN-01–CN-02, AC-01–AC-04.

After T001, implement the catalogue-defined infrastructure `SystemSignalReportSourceAdapter` in `libs/infrastructure/src/signal_report/`, with independently verifiable artifact-read, chain ⓪/① derivation, and non-persistence conformance tests. IN-04, CN-01, AC-04.
After T001, implement filter-to-query conversion in `apps/cli-driver/src/signal_report/`. IN-03, AC-03.
After T001 and T003, implement occurrence rendering in `apps/cli-driver/src/signal_report/`. IN-02, CN-02, AC-02.

After T001, T002, and T004, implement and independently verify `SignalCompositionRoot::signal_report_driver` wiring in `apps/cli-composition/`, before CLI report dispatch consumes it. CN-01, AC-01, AC-04.
After T003, T004, and T006, add signal-report CLI parsing and dispatch through the composition-root report driver in `apps/cli/`. IN-01, IN-03, AC-01, AC-03.
After T005, add `sotp track resolve` regression tests in `apps/cli/src/commands/track/resolve.rs`. OUT-01, AC-05.
